mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND create_time >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 5)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3, 5)

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleAmount FROM orders WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY status

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) THEN o.pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS itemQty FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY day
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} GROUP BY status

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (2, 3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS shipped, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finished, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) THEN pay_amount END), 0) AS avgPay, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3, 5) THEN pay_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS saleAmount FROM orders WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
